title: Pisar ki laash pe zehra ki yeh duhai hai
body:
PISAR KE LAASH PE LAILA KI YEH DUHAI HEY
QAZA BHI QAASID E SUGRA KE SAATH AAYI HEY
HILAA KE LAAL KA SHANA YEH KEHTI THI MAADAR
DUROOD BHEJ KE TAAZIM KO OUTHO AKBAR
ALI KI LAADLI BETI SIRHANEH AAYI HEY
DUA E MAANG NE WAALI BEHN KA KYA HOGA
YEHI THI SUGRA KI YAAD E BASSI HUWI BETA
TUMHAREH SEEN E MEI BARCHI JAHAA SAMAAYI HEY
AKELA PHAL NAHI BARCHI KA NIKLA SEEN E SE
KOI HUSSAIN SE YA RAB NA YEH SAWAAL KARE
JIGAR SE NOK E SINA KIS TARHA CHURAYI HEY
MANAAYI SHAAM KE LASHKAR NE AISE RASM E HILLA
HATHELIYO KI JAGA SURKH HO GAYA SEENA
LAHOO SE MEHNDI MERE LAAL KI RACHAYI HEY
NISAAR SURA E YOUSUF TUMHAREH CHEREH PAR
YEH KAISE ZAKHM HEY MAAR E GAYE HEY KYA PATTHAR
NISHANI AHMAD E MURSAL KI YU MITAAYI HEY
HAMARI QABR PE TUMKO DIYE JALAANE TH
TUMHARE JINNE KE DEEN TH HAMARE MARNE KE
MAGAR YEH MOWT NE KESI GARRI DIKHAYI HEY
DUHAAYI DEHTI THI AKBAR YEH SAYAADA KI BAHOO
BAS AAKEH BAALO MEI LE JAAOU KYA TUMHARA LAHOO
KAHUGI SUQRA SE MAA YEH NISHANI LAAYI HEY
